descriptors.name: cdm.party.EntityIdentifier
descriptors.label: Entity Identifier
descriptors.description: An identifier and its source for a legal entity — LEI, BIC, RED pair id, MIC, country code or other. Realises cdm.base.staticdata.party.EntityIdentifier; embedded inside LegalEntity, no lifecycle of its own.

identifier.name: identifier
identifier.label: Identifier
identifier.description: The identifier value, e.g. the 20-character LEI.

identifierType.name: identifierType
identifierType.label: Identifier Type
identifierType.description: The identifier's source, from cdm.base.staticdata.party.EntityIdentifierTypeEnum (which flattens its parent PartyIdentifierTypeEnum's BIC/LEI/MIC ahead of its own values).
